messages:
Riley: Morning! tiny onboarding snag: I can find a bunch of team pages but not the canonical place for ramp notes or how to contribute back to templates. I only have view access. Any quick steps?
Noah: Welcome Riley! Canonical spot for ramp notes is Docs Home > Personal > Ramp Notes. We prefer people keep personal notes in Private workspace (Private > Onboarding) and add a single public summary if useful.
doc-ops-bot: How-to: Duplicate templates from Docs Home > Templates -> click  -> Duplicate -> choose Private. To request edit perms run: `/doc-access request <page-link>` or email docs@redwood.com. Expected turnaround: same day for typical requests.
Riley: Thanks. I tried `/doc-access` but got back an error about "restricted space". What does that mean?
Chris: Some templates are in restricted Team spaces (legal/compliance/process). Those require a page Owner to approve edits. Check top of page for "Owner:". If Owner is listed, DM them; if it's blank, ping #devex-docs with the link and short reason.
Noah: Quick note on contributing: if you make a local improvement and want it upstream, create a small changelog block at the top: `Derived from: <link>` + `Change: short description` and then submit a docs governance request: Docs Home > Governance > Template updates -> New request.
People Ops: FYI contractors need an approved account and vendor access before we can grant edit rights in restricted spaces. Reach out to people-ops@redwood.com if thats you.
Riley: Any naming conventions for ramp pages so others can find them later?
Noah: Use `Lastname Firstname - Ramp` and add tags `#ramp #role-xyz` in the header. If you want feedback from mentors add an @-mention to your peer.
Chris: Also, small trick: use a public summary page with a link to your private ramp if you want teammates to review without exposing raw notes.
Riley: Got it. I just emailed docs@redwood.com with the page link and requested editor on the template. Appreciate it all :raised_hands:
doc-ops-bot: Request received. Ticket #DOC-4821 created. If no response in 24h run `/doc-help` or escalate to docs-admin@redwood.com. Thread closed.
